events.text: The municipality of Gamvik was established when Tana Municipality was divided into three municipalities.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The municipality of Gamvik was established on 1 January 1914

events.text: Gamvik became part of the newly formed Troms og Finnmark county.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 January 2020 , the municipality became part of the newly formed Troms og Finnmark county

events.text: The coat of arms were granted.
events.subject: self

events.text: Construction started for a landside terminal and running a SOSUS cable into the sea.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June 1972 construction started for [ a landside terminal and ] running a SOSUS cable into the sea .

events.text: A Widerøe Twin Otter crashed into the sea near Mehamn, killing all fifteen on board.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 12 March 1982 , a Widerøe Twin Otter , registration number LN-BNK , crashed into the sea near Mehamn , killing all fifteen on board .

events.text: The all-time high in Gamvik municipality was recorded at Slettnes Lighthouse.

events.quote: The all-time high in Gamvik municipality is recorded at Slettnes Lighthouse in July 1972

events.text: The second warmest was recorded at Slettnes.

events.quote: the second warmest is recorded at Slettnes in July 2018

events.text: The all-time low in Gamvik was recorded at Slettnes.

events.quote: The all-time low in Gamvik is recorded February 1985 at Slettnes
